sections.title: Changing your password
sections.content:
To change your password, do the following:

- Click your avatar in the top right corner → click **Preferences**:

![](/uploads/7b6e1c217a78ac9802f5b4c1.png)

- The system shows a popup → open the **[Account Security] tab** → click **Change password**:

![](/uploads/0bfa5744057d69478d8eee40.png)

- Enter your current password before changing it:

![](/uploads/fc0adacd713c467a514cffb2.png)

- Enter the new password and click **Change password** to finish:

![](/uploads/abf98ea3b874f5be7bfaf9bc.png)

**Note:** After the password is changed, the system signs you out automatically and you have to sign in again with the new password.

sections.title: Switching the language
sections.content:
The system supports two languages, English and Vietnamese. To switch language, do the following:

- Click your avatar in the top right corner → click **Preferences**:

![](/uploads/7b6e1c217a78ac9802f5b4c1.png)

- The system shows a popup → select the language you want → click save:

![](/uploads/a9d5d2844ef1d596cdcb5285.png)

**Note:**

- If you have several tabs open, reload each of the other tabs (F5) after switching so they also display in the new language.

sections.title: Searching for data
sections.content:
Every menu always shows a search bar:

![](/uploads/402ee9cabc1767edfd1c47c6.png)

The example below searches for an order by its order code: type or paste what you are looking for into the search bar (1) → click the search criterion for the order code (2):

![](/uploads/229c81641ec27fd3280905d7.png)

sections.title: Filtering data
sections.content:
## Option 1

Use the search panel (quick filter).

- In some menus the system provides a search panel on the left of the screen. You can filter data quickly there:

![](/uploads/5b25e0f7a85f0cb43aa59d1b.png)

![](/uploads/365bcc9dd7ec9aac9b75e8be.png)

## Option 2

Use the built-in filters. Depending on the menu, the system provides a number of default filters.

- Click the icon at the end of the search bar (1) → select one of the built-in filters under (2):

![](/uploads/322a22462665bc23fb42f97b.png)

## Option 3

Advanced filtering — use this when you want to filter by criteria the system has no built-in filter for.

- Click the icon at the end of the search bar (1) → click **Add Custom Filter** (2):

![](/uploads/4ae1f747f5ff3fc814f2ed00.png)

- The system shows a popup → enter the filter criteria you want (1) → click **Add** to create the new filter.

![](/uploads/d9b7d3e5bfa1dcd23eca2085.png)

- The new filter has been created:

![](/uploads/08eabad62e4993dff6f4e6d4.png)

- Note that a filter created this way is only temporary: it disappears when you move to another screen or reload the page. But there is a way to save it and reuse it later → see [Saving a favorite filter](/d/basic-system-features#saving-a-favorite-filter).

sections.title: The filter navigation bar
sections.content: Once you have created a new filter with **Option 3** in [Filtering data](/d/basic-system-features#filtering-data), the system shows a Filter Navigation Bar below the search bar so you can work faster. How to use it: - Click each tab on the bar to apply the matching filter condition. - The data on screen updates automatically according to the filter you selected. ![](/uploads/6885ac9ec4d789d71896221d.png) You can also show or hide the filter bar to suit how you work. ### Step 1 Click the icon in the top right corner (View Actions). ### Step 2 Find the 'Filter Navigation Bar' option: - ON: show the filter bar. - OFF: hide the filter bar. ![](/uploads/411d455ec58253db58f6e818.png) The result once it is on: ![](/uploads/123194320f7f5cc0c666fb5a.png)

sections.title: The date filter
sections.content:
Every menu in the system provides a search box for date fields:

![](/uploads/33fda39b0e08f85bac292ad0.png)

- The box for choosing which date field to filter on:

![](/uploads/cec87cc3ffedcf8daa90c4b3.png)

- The box for entering the dates to search:

![](/uploads/c9f998497daa85dd19ccc05c.png)

- The search button and the button that clears the search values:

![](/uploads/2f183ac93d0ccb70ec043f9a.png)

- The quick filter box:

  - Click DAY to filter quickly by the current day. Click the ←/→ arrows to move between days.

  - Click WEEK to filter quickly by the current week. Click the ←/→ arrows to move between weeks.

  - Click MONTH to filter quickly by the current month. Click the ←/→ arrows to move between months.

![](/uploads/959450cba6a7d1777100faaf.png)

sections.title: Grouping data
sections.content:
In the search box, click the icon at the end of the box to show the grouping section (group by):

![](/uploads/b0cfda036b07b1c293968703.png)

- Click the criterion you want to group by:

![](/uploads/beb76bd68dbe12e305f1fb91.png)

- To group on several levels: you can click several criteria; the grouping order follows the order in which you clicked them:

![](/uploads/ea16e2737f454bcab7352960.png)

- The data after grouping:

![](/uploads/0d3a8a6255cdde4fa02721ed.png)

- Use this icon to expand the detailed data or collapse it back into groups. If you grouped on several levels, click it repeatedly to expand or collapse one level at a time:

![](/uploads/c4a1b6365259172cde8eb154.png)

sections.title: Saving a favorite filter
sections.content:
Once you have applied filters or grouped the data, you can save that filter or grouping and reuse it later instead of building it again:

- Click the icon at the end of the search bar and the favorite filter section appears:

![](/uploads/c6e3e89a1320a2934d242262.png)

- Click **Save current search (1)**:

  - Enter a name for the filter (2).

  - Tick **Default filter** if you want the system to apply this filter automatically every time you open this screen (3).

  - Tick **Shared** if you want to share this filter with other users (4).

  - Click **Save** to finish (5).

![](/uploads/15f3591044aa183f498eae33.png)

- The filter once it is saved:

![](/uploads/c840edc0902255183f8a1e01.png)

sections.title: Showing and hiding columns
sections.content:
In the list view of some menus the system shows only a few main columns by default. You can click the icon at the end of the header bar to choose which columns to show or hide.
This setting applies only to your own account. Note that clearing your browser cache resets it to the system default. ![](/uploads/1a645c1de82681fd5e6755de.png)

sections.title: Moving between pages of data
sections.content: In the list view, when there is a lot of data the system paginates it. In the example below there are 165 records in total and the system is showing records 1 to 80: - You can click "1-80" to enter how many records you want to show. - Or click the icon to move between pages. ![](/uploads/fd355f3bb6e74383129a5a64.png) ![](/uploads/37234dfcd9dc4d5a9ee162a2.png) **Note:** If the data is grouped, the pagination shows the number of level-1 groups. In the example below — the container and waybill list grouped by order — the pagination shows the number of orders, which is what the data is grouped by. ![](/uploads/1161107d090c5d4439e957a5.png)

sections.title: Changing the row color
sections.content:
This feature lets you change the background color (highlight) of a record so you can:

- Mark important orders

- Sort records quickly by how far along they are

- Follow a list more easily at a glance

## Steps

### Step 1

Tick the record you want to mark.

![](/uploads/8cb713558e8813013fc3d4a5.png)

### Step 2

Click the action button on the toolbar.

![](/uploads/c8c385f7424703f7eb7d1ac3.png)

### Step 3

Select the "Change row color" function.

![](/uploads/f1251eb0500424f34430830a.png)

### Step 4

Choose a color.

- **Option 1**: pick one from the preset palette.

![](/uploads/1bb16eb53ae2cf9d34fcaf2f.png)

- **Option 2**: pick a custom color.

![](/uploads/7f2729f48f958c5ad629bd71.png)

Once you have chosen a color, click 'Update' and the system applies it to the selected record.

## Notes
- You can **select one or several records** and change their color at once.

- The color is only a visual marker; it does not affect any business data.

- The colors available can be configured at system level.
